title: anaphalis contorta
intro: Anaphalis contorta, commonly known as Alpine Pearly Everlasting, is a perennial herb that belongs to the family Asteraceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote digestive health and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal issues, such as bloating and indigestion. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Anaphalis contorta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
